peg.volatility_score_basis: sUSDe is assessed against its accruing USDe NAV, not $1. At block 26,163,612 its NAV was 1.2523843850 USDe per share and the market was 7.28 bps below NAV; no 30-day observation breached -50 bps. The score also carries the changing portfolio risk of the USDe beneath it.

backing.backing_score_basis: sUSDe held 1.213757bn USDe against 969.157m shares, and totalAssets divided by totalSupply matched convertToAssets exactly. It has no independent reserve or cushion, so its economic backing score equals USDe's 6.5 and moves with it. The refreshed USDe feed measured 99.1682% coverage before and 100.4590% after the Reserve Fund.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: The Ethereum sUSDe-to-USDe route last cleared $3.303m at -44.59 bps and first crossed -50 bps at $3.320m. The primary exit is permissionless with a live one-day cooldown, although governance can set as much as 90 days. Non-Ethereum scores use venue evidence, not measured executable ladders.
liquidity.liquidity_score_per_chain_basis: Ethereum is ladder-measured. Other chains are conservative venue-inventory judgments and must not be read as executable crossing measurements.
liquidity.recheck_basis: Monad and Plasma Pendle markets mature on 2026-10-22.

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: sUSDe is a pure wrapper whose sole reserve asset is USDe, so Dependencies equals USDe at 6.0. Aave, Morpho and Pendle are downstream concentration and forced-seller channels, not additional reserve assets.

issuer.issuer_score_basis: sUSDe has the same issuer, governance and operating record as USDe, so Issuer equals USDe at 7.0. Wrapper-specific administration is assessed under Contract and Admin.

coverage_note: All six canonical axes were refreshed. Backing, Dependencies and Issuer inherit from the completed USDe assessment; Peg, Liquidity and Contract/Admin were remeasured for the wrapper.
